message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Nakheel signed a contract with Parkway International Contracting LLC for over AED 950 million to build 617 homes at Bay Grove Residences on Dubai Islands.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The contract covers phases 2 and 4, including residential buildings, infrastructure, and recreational areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]},{"claim":"Completion of phase 2 is planned by the end of 2028.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Completion of phase 4 is planned in the second quarter of 2029.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The total value of contracts for all 1,154 homes exceeds AED 1.75 billion.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Emirates Dubai 7s adds HSBC SVNS 3 with 28 teams.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The tournament will take place from November 27 to 29 in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"It is the world's biggest international rugby sevens tournament.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5]},{"claim":"There will be 28 men's and women's teams competing and 70 matches played.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5]},{"claim":"Top teams include New Zealand, South Africa, Australia, and others.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,4]},{"claim":"HSBC SVNS 3 provides teams the opportunity to progress towards Olympic qualification.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Tickets for the event are already on sale.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Najah Dubai 2026 exhibition opened in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,3]},{"claim":"The exhibition will run until 27 October.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The exhibition is held at Za’abeel Hall 5, Dubai World Trade Centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The event gathered more than 100 universities from 20 countries, including UAE, USA, Canada, and the UK.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4]},{"claim":"Visitors can get information about study programs, admission requirements, scholarships, and career prospects.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,6,7]},{"claim":"The exhibition features more than 30 seminars with experts on education and career planning.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Etihad Rail and Citymapper have launched an integration to simplify journey planning in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The integration allows planning trips using rail, metro, bus, and other transport modes via the Citymapper app.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Passenger services of Etihad Rail started on 30 September in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Al Dhaid, and Fujairah.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Users can now easily combine different transport modes for convenient travel across the country.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4]},{"claim":"The partnership aims to improve accessibility and convenience of public transport in the UAE and reduce journey planning complexity.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае одобрили План развития городских центров с бюджетом более 2 млрд дирхамов до 2040 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,11,12]},{"claim":"План охватывает 6 основных и 42 вспомогательных центров.","supported":true,"evidence":[11,12,13]},{"claim":"План направлен на повышение качества жизни и эффективности инфраструктуры.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13]},{"claim":"Утверждена Политика устойчивого планирования населения, связывающая рост населения с экономическим и городским развитием.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,13,14]},{"claim":"Введена цифровая система авторизации для упрощения государственных услуг с использованием цифровой идентификации UAE PASS.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,16,17,18]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, new practical driving test rules will take effect in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,20]},{"claim":"To pass the test, a minimum score of 75% is required.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Dangerous mistakes can lead to automatic failure even if the overall score is high.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,8]},{"claim":"Examples of dangerous mistakes include losing control of the car, hitting a kerb, ignoring traffic signs, and dangerous gear changes.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]},{"claim":"If the examiner intervenes to prevent an accident, the candidate can fail automatically.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"The rules apply to all candidates taking tests from January 1, 2027, regardless of when they started training.","supported":true,"evidence":[19,20]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Embassy of India in Abu Dhabi and the Consulate General of India in Dubai urged Indian tourists and residents to check the presence and adequacy of medical insurance.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4]},{"claim":"It is recommended to obtain insurance policies covering emergency medical care and repatriation to India.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,7]},{"claim":"Indians already living in the UAE are advised to ensure their insurance covers all medical expenses and possible repatriation.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Абу-Даби планируют открыть мостовой комплекс на острове Рамхан во втором квартале 2027 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Проект включает семь мостов, три туннеля и дорожную сеть, соединяющую острова Рамхан и Джубайл с шоссе Шейха Халифы (E12).","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"Общая площадь строительства превысит 166 000 кв. м.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Стоимость составит около 872 млн дирхамов.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"В проекте предусмотрены энергосберегающие LED-светильники.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"В проекте предусмотрена переработка 90% строительных отходов.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Sharjah temporarily closed all its beaches due to an oil spill.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The closure was done to prevent pollution and ensure safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Al Hamriyah Beach was closed earlier on October 23.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Similar measures were taken in Umm Al Quwain and Ras Al Khaimah, where all beaches are closed until assessments and protective measures are completed.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11]},{"claim":"Fishermen temporarily do not go to sea.","supported":true,"evidence":[14]},{"claim":"Fresh supplies continue to arrive at Umm Al Quwain fish market from Oman.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The UAE launched an upgraded Wage Protection System (WPS) that enables employers to manage salary payments digitally without paperwork or visiting banks.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The system was developed with the participation of the Central Bank of the UAE and Al Etihad Payments.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded system enables real-time data exchange and is connected to 17 financial institutions including major banks and exchange centers.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The WPS covers more than 99% of private-sector workers with average monthly wage transfers of about AED 37 billion.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded platform accelerates salary processing, increases transparency, and supports financial inclusion aligned with the We the UAE 2031 strategy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3] }]}
